name: Theory of Computation
description:
Introduction to the Theory of Computation: Proof Techniques, Basic concepts of
language, Grammar and Automata; Chomsky Hierarchy, Regular Languages, Finite
automata, Equivalence, DFA and NFA, Minimization, Myhill-Nerode Theorem;
Context Free Grammar, Pushdown Automata, their equivalence and Application,
Properties of Context-Free Languages; Turing Machine, Recursive and Recursively
Enumerable Languages, Undecidability, Rice's Theorem, Post's Correspondence
Problem, Complexity Theory, Intractable Problems.
